arguments.prompt:
Create one native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Barbara. FIXED INCARNATION: Rayman Legends (2013), default Barbara. APPEARANCE: Red-haired Viking princess Barbara with two long red braids, winged metal helmet, green practical tunic, brown belt and boots; complete double-headed axe.. EQUIPMENT AND ROLE: two-handed physical axe. SOURCE ACTION: Grand balayage de Barbara. Barbara is a playable axe wielder in Rayman Legends; retain her axe attack rather than inventing a princess rescue spell.

Detailed clean16-bit pixel art. Consistent three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT. EXACTLY48 COMPLETE INDEPENDENTLY DRAWN FIGURES, EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS (8x6). Every consecutive FOUR figures is a four-pose sequence. Every full head, native limbs, wings, tail and complete tool must remain inside its own cell. Draw slightly smaller bodies and GENEROUS TRANSPARENT GUTTERS with a32px outer margin. No overlapping figures, touching silhouettes, labels, text, numbers, grid, scenery, ground, shadows or watermark. Transparent background.

ROW1 columns1-4 INTRO: four different approaching/ready postures. Columns5-8 OUTRO: lower tools/hands, turn, depart, settle.
ROW2 columns1-4 ROUND VICTORY: four brief source-personality acknowledgments. Columns5-8 ROUND LOSS: four different disappointed/breathing/steady postures, completely unharmed.
ROW3 columns1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Barbara grips her real complete axe: ready, wind up, a complete physical axe swing in THIRD pose, recover. No axe tip touches a neighbouring cell, no magic beam. Columns5-8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinct celebrations DIFFERENT from the round-win group.
ROW4 columns1-4 MATCH LOSS: four different disappointed/crouched/recovering postures, unharmed. Columns5-8 SUPER: Barbara grips her real complete axe: ready, wind up, a complete physical axe swing in THIRD pose, recover. No axe tip touches a neighbouring cell, no magic beam. Four NEW drawings, different from row3.
ROW5 columns1-4 IDLE: four different breathing/weight/wing/ear poses. Columns5-8 RUN: four actual alternating locomotion strides; flying or serpentine movement uses the real anatomy.
ROW6 columns1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Four distinct postures for the named ordinary source action: Coup de hache de Barbara. Prepare, aim or wind up, real source action in THIRD pose, recover. Keep the exact fixed anatomy and tool. No unrelated power or missing equipment. Columns5-8 HIT REACTION: four gentle flinch/steady/recover postures, complete and unharmed.

All48 are genuinely DIFFERENT DRAWINGS, never copied, shifted, mirrored, recoloured or padded duplicates. No attack or flash outside attack groups. No victim, blood, wounds, corpse, dismemberment or injury. Friendly solo game animation. These are original adapted drawings, not official game sprite frames.

output_hint:

The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
